name: Exp_CHOWithFlat
summary: This EA trades based on the Chaikin Oscillator with Flat (CHOWithFlat) custom indicator, which combines Bollinger Bands with a smoothed Chaikin Oscillator to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the oscillator's upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions when the opposite occurs. The EA includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate toggles for entry and exit signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于带平坦区的蔡金振荡器（CHOWithFlat）自定义指标进行交易，结合布林带与平滑蔡金振荡器来检测动量转换。当振荡器上线上穿下线时开多仓，反之下穿时开空仓。EA包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及独立的入场/出场信号开关。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用CHOWithFlat自定义指标作为核心交易信号源，该指标本质上是蔡金振荡器（Chaikin Oscillator）与布林带平坦区过滤的结合体。入场条件：当指标上线(Up)在下线(Dn)之上且前一周期上线低于下线时，触发买入信号；当上线在下线之下且前一周期上线高于下线时，触发卖出信号。出场条件分为主动出场和信号出场两种：主动出场由止损和止盈参数控制，信号出场则由买卖仓位关闭开关与反向交叉信号共同决定。仓位管理采用基于资金的模式，通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持LOT和PERCENT两种保证金模式。资金管理方面，使用固定手数或百分比模式，配合1000点止损和2000点止盈，风险回报比为1:2。策略在信号生成时还引入了新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓，但缺少对现有持仓的检查逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the CHOWithFlat custom indicator as its core signal source, which is essentially a combination of the Chaikin Oscillator with Bollinger Band flat-zone filtering. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's upper line (Up) is above the lower line (Dn) and the previous period's Up was below Dn, indicating a bullish crossover; conversely, a sell signal triggers on a bearish crossover. Exit conditions are twofold: mandatory exits are governed by stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), while signal-based exits are controlled by the BuyPosClose/SellPosClose toggles which close positions on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a money management model controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1), supporting both LOT and PERCENT margin modes via the MMMode enumeration. The risk-reward ratio is set at 1:2 with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The strategy incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate entries within the same candle, but critically lacks a check for existing open positions before sending new orders, which could lead to position accumulation.

pros: 使用蔡金振荡器结合布林带平坦区过滤，能有效识别市场从盘整到趋势的转换
提供独立的买卖入场/出场开关，灵活性高，可以只做单向交易
支持10种平滑方法，指标参数高度可定制
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复产生信号
风险回报比设置为1:2，理论上盈利空间大于亏损空间
pros_en: Combines Chaikin Oscillator with Bollinger Band flat-zone filtering to effectively identify transitions from consolidation to trending markets
Provides independent buy/sell entry and exit toggles for high flexibility, allowing unidirectional trading only
Supports 10 smoothing methods, making indicator parameters highly customizable
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signal generation within the same candle
Risk-reward ratio set at 1:2, providing theoretically larger profit potential than loss exposure
cons: 缺少现有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓导致仓位堆积
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损可能被轻易触发
1000点的止损较大，对小账户资金管理风险较高
依赖外部自定义指标CHOWithFlat，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
信号仅在K线交叉时产生，在剧烈行情中可能错过快速入场机会
cons_en: Lacks existing position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction and causing position accumulation
No spread filter, meaning stop loss can be easily triggered in high-spread environments
The 1000-point stop loss is relatively large, posing higher risk for small accounts
Depends on the external CHOWithFlat custom indicator file; if missing, the EA cannot run
Signals only generate on bar crossovers, potentially missing fast entry opportunities during volatile market conditions
improvements: 添加现有持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认是否已有同向持仓，避免仓位重复堆积
增加点差过滤和时间交易过滤（如避开新闻时段和低流动性时段），提高交易质量
improvements_en: Add existing position check logic before opening new orders to confirm no same-direction positions exist, preventing position accumulation
Add spread filter and session/time filter (e.g., avoid news events and low liquidity periods) to improve trade quality

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能导致同方向仓位无限叠加
止损1000点较大，在极端行情中单笔亏损可能较大
缺少点差过滤，高点差品种可能频繁止损
risk_points_en: No position check could lead to unlimited accumulation of same-direction positions
The 1000-point stop loss is large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses during extreme market conditions
No spread filter means high-spread instruments may trigger stop losses frequently
